notes.publish: no direct path: omitted proposalId becomes an implicit gated proposal
notes.rollback: rollbackTo switches the pointer; both graphs are kept

notes.pages: PDF pages; office/text/HTML recorded as page 1

notes.chinese: `simple` has no word segmentation; pg_trgm covers substring match

notes.chain: rdfs(jena riot) -> owl(robot/elk) -> shacl gate; one target graph

notes.degrade: graph down -> chunks only; search down -> facts only

notes.undo: adjudication is reversible via unmerged/resolution_undo events

notes: no auth, no metrics/tracing, no job queue or event bus
OCR is disabled; scanned PDFs are returned as degraded with NO_OCR_ENABLED
embedding unavailable -> hybrid search returns lexical results with degraded=true
extraction candidates are approval-gated: nothing is written to the graph before approval
llm is OpenAI-compatible and optional: auto mode degrades to rules when unconfigured
reasoning materializes into a separate graph; source graphs are never overwritten
SHACL without shapes is an explicit Unsupported error, never a silent pass
